findings.title: Authenticated content may be cached
findings.details: `/allowAuthorized "1"` instructs the dispatcher to cache responses for authenticated requests. This risks serving one user's private content to another.

findings.title: Cache allow-all with no deny overrides
findings.details: The cache rules contain `/glob "*" /type "allow"` as the only rule — every URL including admin paths will be cached. Add explicit deny overrides for `/crx/*`, `/system/*`, `/bin/*`, `/libs/*`, and `/conf/*`.

findings.title: /bin/* cached — Sling servlet endpoints cached
findings.details: Line 13: `/bin/*` — Caching `/bin/*` exposes all Sling servlet endpoints. Add a specific deny rule or remove this allow rule.

findings.title: /crx/* cached — AEM repository browser exposed
findings.details: Line 14: `/crx/*` — Caching `/crx/*` allows unauthenticated access to the CRX repository browser and package manager. Remove this rule entirely.

findings.title: /system/* cached — AEM system console exposed
findings.details: Line 15: `/system/*` — Caching `/system/*` exposes the Felix OSGi console and health-check endpoints. Remove this rule entirely.

findings.title: /libs/* cached — AEM internal path exposed
findings.details: Line 16: `/libs/*` is cached. `/libs/*` and `/conf/*` contain AEM framework files and OSGi configurations that should not be publicly cached.

findings.title: /conf/* cached — AEM internal path exposed
findings.details: Line 17: `/conf/*` is cached. `/libs/*` and `/conf/*` contain AEM framework files and OSGi configurations that should not be publicly cached.

findings.title: All query parameters used as cache keys
findings.details: The `ignoreUrlParams` block contains `/glob "*" /type "allow"`, meaning every query parameter is included in the cache key. UTM/tracking params will fragment the cache and reduce hit rate. Explicitly ignore known tracking params.
